title: Provide github oauth scope as comma-delimited string
description: as indicated by [the docs](https://flask-dance.readthedocs.io/en/latest/providers.html#module-flask_dance.contrib.github) and the mismatched scope errors we're now seeing.

title: Use correct redirect value for github oauth
changes made to fix github oauth flow
description: fixing github oath flow, related to issue #141

title: Bump tested python versions + actions step versions
Resize/renumber the default VPC CidrBlocks
description:
Fixes #137

Also avoid 172.17.0.0/16 block used by AWS Cloud9 and SageMaker per https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-cidr-blocks.html

I think to pick up this change folks might need to tear down/redeploy their fuzzbucket deployment?

title: Add `api` command to client as escape hatch
description: for when otherwise-undefined API tomfoolery is needed

title: Support optional glob match in client `ls`
description: plus some testing improvements

title: Remaining API compatibility with older clients
Add missing API compat mapping
description: and turn off strict slashes so that earlier versions of fuzzbucket-client can still work

title: Ensure the reap function also has AWSLambdaPowertoolsPythonV2 layer
description: so that attempting to import `aws_lambda_powertools` doesn't result in `ImportError`

title: Check session for `_user_id`, too
description: since that's what `flask-login` sets. I'll have to poke around more to see if I can remove `"user"`.

title: Add support to automatically use SSM
description: when no public DNS name is available, plus support to use SSM "always" or "never", and via `FUZZBUCKET_SSM` environment variable by default.

title: Update CHANGELOG with latest goodies
description: plus cleaning up formatting back through 2022

title: Share resources in a more flasky way
description: and use powertools logging extra keywords better

title: Use `Flask-Login` instead of homegrown things
description: plus (begin to) switch to aws powertools logging

title: Move flask app parts into blueprints
description: plus related renaming and import style cleanups

title: Add support for Okta as auth provider
description:
Closes #103

This set of changes is a bit more damp than I'd like given the mutual exclusivity of GitHub and Okta (generic OAuth2) providers and subtle differences between them. Maybe more drying later?

title: Add support for managing instances in externally-defined VPC
description:
along with too many other (overdue imho) modernizations and cleanups that Felt Right At The Time 😅 

Closes #109

title: Many modernizing steps
description: that I wanted to get done before taking on #103 or #109

title: Include version and region in response headers
description: for better observability ™️ ✨

title: Support using SSH and SCP via SSM proxy
description: Closes #110

title: Download into the dist dir for publish compat
Skip reaping instances that fail to terminate
description:
Closes #108 

Plus moving the VPC tagging into customization layer and filling in more of what may be customized in `default-custom.yml`

title: Clean up some housekeeping bits after 0.10.0
Support (somewhat) box updates
description:
While very little can be updated for a given box, the ability to change the tags will allow for support of extending a given box's TTL as described in #88. Maybe more updating can be added in the future 🤷🏼 

```bash
fuzzbucket-client update ubuntu20 --ttl '2 weeks'
```

In addition to the `update` command, there is also a `--check-ttl` top-level flag for experimenting with TTL values, e.g.:

```bash
fuzzbucket-client --check-ttl '4 weeks, 3 days'
```

Closes #88

title: Switch from API keys to GitHub OAuth2
description:
This change will eliminate the need for distributing API keys that are known to folks with relevant AWS access, as well as having to distribute *new* API keys in the event of the deployed fuzzbucket API having to be rebuilt or altered in a way that triggers key rotation. The existing `FUZZBUCKET_URL` value will still work, and will be the only config item that needs to be distributed.

With `FUZZBUCKET_URL` set in one's environment, running any `fuzzbucket-client` operations that require communication with the `fuzzbucket` API will check for GitHub authorization. In the event that there is no GitHub token stored by the `fuzzbucket` API, an error message will be printed out informing the human that they must run `fuzzbucket-client login <github-username>`. Upon completion of the login flow, a secret will be cached in `~/.cache/fuzzbucket/credentials` specific to the value of `FUZZBUCKET_URL` for future authentication needs.

Closes #29
